stem.text: An object is moving along the ground in a straight line at a constant speed.
Which statement about the resultant force acting on the object is correct?

A.text: The resultant force acting on the object is equal to its weight.

B.text: The resultant force acting on the object is equal to the product of its mass and its velocity.

C.text: The resultant force acting on the object is equal to the resistive force.

D.text: The resultant force acting on the object is equal to zero.
